'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Jonny Chu LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
